description: A ground-level photograph depicts a dense coniferous forest. The scene is dominated by numerous tall, slender tree trunks with a textured bark, suggesting mature coniferous trees. The forest floor is extensively covered with a vibrant green undergrowth consisting of mosses and various grasses, indicating a humid or moist environment, possibly a peaty substrate. Sunlight filters through the canopy, creating dappled lighting on the forest floor. Faint text in the bottom left corner identifies the image source as "CLMS Product Examples" and the URL "https://land.copernicus.eu/imagegallery". This image serves as an example of a coniferous forest type as categorised by the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS), consistent with definitions for natural or semi-natural coniferous forests or coniferous swamp forests.
